thread:
rachel: :rotating_light: Heads up — we're seeing ingress backpressure in eu-central that is causing queued requests and intermittent 504s for streaming and long-context calls. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2198765432

ops-bot: Incident INC-2198765432 opened. Tags: hosted, eu-central, streaming, customer-impact. Runbook: https://git.redwood.ai/incidents/runbooks/ingress-backpressure

devon: Impact estimate: ~8% of requests in eu-central affected, p95 latency up to 9s for streams, some reconnect loops observed. Synthetic monitors show retry storms around 10:12 UTC.

claire: Root cause hypothesis: an ordering regression in the sharded ingress broker caused unfair dequeue ordering under certain high-fanout workloads. Reproducer attached in thread.

rachel: Mitigations in flight: 1) enable ingress soft-drop on noisy routes, 2) toggle fair-queueing flag to old scheduler, 3) route heavy-streaming tenants to fallback region (eu-west1) for critical customers. Started at 10:25 UTC.

sam: Canary of scheduler rollback on 4 routers showing immediate decrease in queue depth. p95 down from 8.9s -> 3.2s on canary. Metrics: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/ingress/eu-central-fanout

devon: Deployed fastfix PR #8590 to avoid deadlock in broker reorder path; build 0.40.2 canarying on 6 routers. Logs: ```2026-03-23T10:28:14Z broker: reorder-resolved shard=7 request=xyz987```

claire: NOTE: Do not restart ingress-proxy pods during canary — restarts currently cause brief reconnect spikes. @ops-bot please add a no-restart tag.

ops-bot: Action: no restarts unless SEV escalates 3. Acknowledged.

product-ops: We're preparing a short customer note for affected accounts and a heads-up to CS. ETA for full resolution estimate?

rachel: If canary continues to look good for 20m we'll roll cluster-wide and then lift soft-drops. Estimated fully resolved by 11:05 UTC.

sam: After full rollout, we'll run a 30m soak with reduced throttles and then remove region fallbacks. Postmortem owners: devon + claire. Postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/2198765432/postmortem

ops-bot: Update INC-2198765432 at 10:58 UTC: full rollout started. Early signals: errors falling, queue depth normalizing. Continue monitoring.

rachel: Final update 11:12 UTC: full rollout complete, soft-drops removed. p95 returned to baseline for all tenants. Closing active mitigation window; follow-ups in postmortem and #postmortems tomorrow 14:00 UTC. Thank you all.
